notes: §1985:VII.3.3.3 GR5: 'If the associated file connector is an external file connector, all BLOCK CONTAINS clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must have the same value for integer-1 and integer-2.' The gap of the prior PARTIAL read is closed (kb/Work PB5300): BindBlockContainsClause records the clause's integers in FileModel.FdClauses under FileDescriptionIdentity.Block, and ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check, called from BinderDriver.Bind, runs CheckFileDescriptions below COBOL-2002, which compares each entry that writes the clause with the first entry of the run unit that writes it and reports COBOL6847; an entry with no clause is skipped, as 1985 constrains only the clauses present. Probed at --std 85 (two programs, one compilation group, an EXTERNAL sequential file written by both and read back): (b) 1 TO 4 RECORDS against 10 RECORDS, 4 RECORDS against 80 CHARACTERS, 4 against 1 TO 4 and 2 TO 4 against 3 TO 4 give COBOL6847; agreeing 1 TO 4 RECORDS, 4 RECORDS against BLOCK 4 (optional words dropped), a clause against none, and 4 RECORDS against 4 CHARACTERS (the same integers, which is all the rule compares) compile and run, reading ABCDE and HELLO back. Between separately compiled elements nothing compares the clause; §1985:I.1.6 leaves a violation's result undefined. The witness writes 1 TO 4 RECORDS in both programs. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5069 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5300 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "all BLOCK CONTAINS clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must have the same value for integer-1 and integer-2"; 2023: "If any of the file description entries has a BLOCK CONTAINS clause, all shall have a BLOCK CONTAINS clause specifying the same minimum and maximum size". 1985 constrains only the BLOCK CONTAINS clauses present. 2023 also requires that every entry for the external connector have the clause once any one has it, so it refuses programs 1985 accepted.
